message: The other day, I was cooking up a storm when my smoke alarm decided it was the perfect time to remind me it was there. Instead of panicking, I remembered my family’s escape plan and calmly led everyone outside. Turns out, the smoke was just from some slightly overcooked veggies. But hey, we got a little fresh air and a chance to practice our plan! Sometimes, those small wins can make all the difference in staying ready for anything. What’s your go-to escape route?
